title: Atlas DataFlow Runtime Contract
description: Minimum runtime contract schema for Atlas DataFlow. Defines the accepted inference features, their types, domain constraints, and schema version for a published dataset release. This is the source of truth for payload validation and inference. It does not contain public-facing rendering hints, UI labels, display ordering, or input type hints — those belong exclusively to the public contract (M4-02).

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semantic version format (e.g., "1.0.0"). Required. Stable and explicit — not a timestamp, file hash, or implicit value. Used by M4-03 structural validation to detect version incompatibilities. The first cycle uses "1.0.0".

features.description: Non-empty list of accepted inference features. Each feature declares its identifier, type, optional payload presence requirement, optional domain constraints, and optional description.

_example_note.description: Optional annotation for example or demonstration artifacts only. Not used during payload validation or inference. Omit in production runtime contracts.

feature.description: A single accepted inference feature. Required fields: name, type. Optional fields: required (payload presence, defaults to true if absent), domain_constraints (value bounds — shape depends on type), description.

name.description: Feature identifier. Must match the key used in inference payloads.

type.description: Feature type. Vocabulary is bounded to the minimum needed for the first cycle: numeric (continuous or discrete numeric value), categorical (enumerated string value), boolean (true/false value). Extend only when a concrete dataset requires an additional type.

required.description: Whether this feature must be present in a valid inference payload. Defaults to true if absent. Features with required: false may be absent from an inference payload without triggering a validation failure in M4-04.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this feature for documentation purposes only. Not used in validation or inference.

domain_constraints.description: Optional structural constraints on the accepted value domain. Shape is determined by the feature type: numeric_domain_constraints (min/max) for numeric features; categorical_domain_constraints (values list) for categorical features. Must be absent for boolean features.

numeric_domain_constraints.description: Value domain constraints for numeric features. Defines the accepted range. At least one of min or max should be declared when domain_constraints is present. Both are optional to accommodate one-sided range constraints.

min.description: Minimum accepted value (inclusive) for this numeric feature.

max.description: Maximum accepted value (inclusive) for this numeric feature.

categorical_domain_constraints.description: Value domain constraints for categorical features. Defines the complete enumerated set of accepted string values.

values.description: Non-empty list of accepted string values for this categorical feature. Only values in this list are considered valid in an inference payload.
